mekki-muskil:2-2.t: His saying (وطور سينين): this is a dialectal form of (سيناء), and it has already been mentioned.

mekki-muskil:3-3.t:
His saying (وهذا البلد): the noun in (هذا) is (ذا) according to the Basrans, while according to the Kufans the dhāl alone is the noun. It is an indeclinable (mabnī) vague noun (ism mubham). It was made indeclinable only because it does not specify a particular named thing but moves to everything pointed at, so it does not settle on any particular thing; thus it differs from the nouns, and by differing from the nouns it came to resemble the particles, since particles differ from nouns; so it was made indeclinable as particles are. Al-Farrāʾ said: it is not declined only because its end is an alif, and the alif does not take a vowel. This is a weak view, which would entail the indeclinability of (موسى), (عصا), (مثنى) and the like. This has already been mentioned more fully than this.
His saying (فما يكذبك بعد): (ما) is an interrogative, nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (يكذبك) is the khabar (predicate).

mekki-muskil:8-8.t: His saying (بأحكم الحاكمين): (أحكم) is declined, although it is an adjective on the pattern of the verb, only because it is annexed, so it departed from resemblance to verbs, since verbs are not annexed; so it is declined into the genitive.
